items.source:
Thrown when the resolution of placeholder failed. This exception provides
the placeholder as well as the hierarchy of values that led to the issue.
items.translation: 抛出占位符解析失败时的异常。此异常提供了占位符以及导致该问题的值层次结构。

items.source: Return the placeholder that could not be resolved.
items.translation: 返回无法解析的占位符。

items.source:
Return a contextualized list of the resolution attempts that led to this
exception, where the first element is the value that generated this
exception.
items.translation: 返回一个上下文相关的解析尝试列表，其中第一个元素是引发此异常的值。

items.source: the stack of values that led to this exception
